The resulting hypercohomology is the simplicial cohomology of the dual complex. Theorem 4.4 proof explicitly proves every K_a with |a|<=r contractible by convex cover nerve, and K_0 equals the dual complex because 0 belongs to every independence polytope. This yields H^0=C and H^i=0 for i>0 under the claimed hypotheses, but it is already implied by the source.
